acip: RTAGS DANG PO MA GRUB NA, YOD PA DANG MA 'BREL BA CHOS CAN, YOD PA DANG 'GAL BA DANG 'GAL BA YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD YOD PA DANG 'GAL BA DANG THA DAD, KHYOD YANG YIN, YOD PA DANG 'GAL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN PA MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: rtags dang po ma grub na, yod pa dang ma 'brel ba chos can, yod pa dang 'gal ba dang 'gal ba yin par thal, khyod yod pa dang 'gal ba dang tha dad, khyod yang yin, yod pa dang 'gal ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa med pa'i phyir
english: I disagree to the first part of that last reason: it is not the case that something which is not related to existence is contradictory to what is contradictory to existence. Suppose you do disagree. Let's consider then something which is not related to existence. It is too contradictory with what is contradictory to existence, Because (1) it is different from what is contradictory to existence; and (2) there exists no example of something which is both it and also contradictory to existence.
